findings.statement: The KRAS p.Gly12Val variant is a well-characterized oncogenic driver in pancreatic adenocarcinoma that constitutively activates the MAPK/PI3K signaling pathways. The CDKN2A p.Arg58Ter variant results in a loss-of-function truncation, disrupting cell cycle regulation.

The detected variants are classified as somatic alterations based on matched tumor-normal analysis using the MSK-IMPACT targeted sequencing assay, confirming their presence in the primary tumor tissue.
